name: black-hole-pyramid
description: Black Hole Pyramid - a fast, tactical abstract duel for mobile and Steam.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:smoke
scripts.setup:desktop: npm i -D electron@^33 electron-builder@^25 && npm i steamworks.js@^0.4
scripts.mobile:add: cap add android && cap add ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
